fieldContext.note: Functional Size Measurement (FSM) evaluates requirement volume (e.g. IFPUG Function Points, NESMA, COSMIC) or Agile Story Points. Volume is used to estimate project effort, cost, and defect density.

personalNotes: Requirements quality indicators evaluate individual requirement statements and overall specifications against the desirable properties defined in Section 3.1.
